gash.definition:
n a wound made by cutting
n a trench resembling a furrow that was made by erosion or excavation
n a strong sweeping cut made with a sharp instrument
v cut open
gash.translation:
n. 深长的伤口, 很深的裂缝
v. (使)负深伤, 划开, 砍入很深

gashed.translation: v. 划伤, 割破( gash的过去式和过去分词 )
